A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same TSRL research work, with readable text, equations, five figures and two tables. All ten pages of each were inspected; both end with references and contain no appendix.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original baseline retraining and TSRL evaluations in Table 1, plus CORE curriculum ablations in Table 2.

after.justification: Section 4 retains the original TSRL evaluations and CORE ablation results in Tables 1–2. These include experiments performed by the authors, not solely results attributed to prior work.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.3 retain the same history-aware state, continuous sample weighting, state-change reward, behavioral cloning, student warmup and PPO training procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions train on FF++ c23 and evaluate on CDF-v2, DFD, DFDC, DFDCP and the same eight DF40 manipulation methods in Table 1. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same six retrained baseline families—I ID, CLIP, CORE, UCF, ProDet and Effort—and nine additional comparison methods. Table 2 retains CORE, CORE + CL and CORE + TSRL.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 preserves the preprocessing, baseline configurations, FF++ c23 training and cross-dataset/cross-method evaluation protocols. Video-level AUC and the additional ACC/EER metrics in Table 2 are unchanged.

E4.justification: The CORE curriculum ablation in Table 2/Figure 4, hard-sample reduction analysis in Figure 1 and UMAP analysis in Figure 5 are retained. Figure 5's minor rendering differences introduce no new analytical comparison.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, error bars or formal significance tests. The same point-estimate reporting is retained.

E6.justification: All reported numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains Effort + TSRL average AUCs of 0.903 and 0.942, while Table 2 retains CORE/CORE + CL/CORE + TSRL average AUCs of 0.814/0.817/0.855.

T1.justification: Equations 1–7 retain identical state, EMA, weighting, reward, behavioral-cloning and PPO definitions. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion preserve the same contributions and claims concerning adaptive sample weighting, history-aware states, state-change rewards and improved generalization.

C2.justification: The explanations of dynamic curriculum benefits and Figure 5's feature-space separation are unchanged. No substantive interpretation, applicability boundary or limitation is added or revised.

D1.justification: Both versions disclose the same actor/critic learning rates of 1e-4/3e-4, DeepfakeBench configuration and preprocessing references, training description and code-access link.

R1.justification: Section 2, the novelty positioning relative to curriculum learning and reinforcement learning, and all 40 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1, 25 March 2026 to v2, 20 May 2026. The title, authors, scientific prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 5's two raster panels show slight rendering and size differences, with tiny spacing shifts on page 8. Their plot structures, labels, annotations and caption remain the same; other figures and both tables are unchanged.

improvement.justification: The method, experimental evidence, claims and reproducibility information remain unchanged. The updated arXiv stamp and negligible Figure 5 rendering/spacing adjustments do not materially improve or weaken the paper's scientific support or readability.
